blocks.text: Khushki ke janwar teen raston se pani khote hain: saans ki sateh (respiratory surfaces) se bukhaarat (evaporation), jild se, aur fuzlaat (waste) ke ikhraj ke saath. Inhen yeh yaqeeni banana hota hai ke pani ki aamad (peene aur khane se) aur metabolic pani (jism ke andar kimiyai amal se banne wala pani) mil kar utne hon jitna pani mahol mein zaya hota hai. In janwaron mein osmotic tawazun rakhne ke liye jismani banawat (anatomical), jism ke kaam (physiological) aur rawayye (behavioral) ki adaptations (mutabiqat) hoti hain.

In ki bahar ki tahen (outer layers) aisi hoti hain jin se pani mushkil se guzarta hai (relatively impermeable), taa ke bukhaarat se pani zaya na ho. Maslan insects ka chitin se bana moom wala (waxy) bahar ka dhancha (exoskeleton) hota hai. Reptiles ke keratin se bane waterproof chhilke (scales) hote hain. Mammals aur birds ki jild ke bahar murda, keratin wale cells hote hain, aur jild mein tel banane wale glands bhi hote hain.

In ke gurde (kidneys) pani ko jism ke andar rokne mein bohat aham kirdar ada karte hain. Mazeed yeh ke yeh protein ke metabolism ke bunyadi fuzle ammonia ko urea ya uric acid mein badal dete hain, jinhen nikalne ke liye kam pani chahiye.

Bohat se registani (desert) janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain taa ke bukhaarat se pani zaya na ho. Yeh sirf raat ko bahar nikalte hain jab hawa thandi aur zyada nam (humid) hoti hai. Yeh registani podon ke beej khate hain jin mein bohat sa carbohydrate jama hota hai. Kuch janwar, jaise kangaroo rat, sirf metabolic pani par zinda reh lete hain (yeh pani cellular respiration mein zimni paidawar ke taur par banta hai).

blocks.title: Anhydrobiosis (pani ke baghair zindagi):
blocks.text: Kuch invertebrates, jaise tardigrades (water bears), jab jism ka taqreeban sara pani kho dete hain to ek soi hui (dormant) halat mein chale jate hain. Saalon baad jab pani wapas milta hai to yeh dobara zinda aur sargarm ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ki machhli patla aur samundari haddi wali machhli gaarha peshab kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ki machhli osmosis se pani hasil karti rehti aur izafi pani nikalna parta hai; samundari machhli pani khoti rehti aur har qatra bachana parta hai, to thora, gaarha peshab nikalti hai.

items: Meetha pani: janwar hypertonic; pani andar aata, namak bahar jata; bohat sa patla peshab, namak active transport se wapas, pani nahin peete.
Samundar: janwar hypotonic; pani bahar jata, namak andar aata; samundari pani peena, thora gaarha peshab, gills ke chloride cells, gurde aur rectal glands namak nikalte hain.
Khushki: pani-band bahar ki tahen (chitin, keratin), pani bachane wale gurde, ammonia se urea ya uric acid, din mein zameen ke andar rehna, metabolic pani.
